data.name: Living Construct
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you can affect constructs with magic as if they were living creatures. Once per day, you can target a construct with a spell or spell-like ability, and the spell resolves as if the construct's creature type were humanoid. This can bypass intelligent constructs' immunity to mind-affecting effects, but mindless constructs remain unaffected.
